label: Finance Team
blurb: A CFO with analysis, pricing, cash and investor updates
purpose: For a business that has its bookkeeping in place and needs to plan ahead: budgets, forecasts, pricing and fundraising. The CFO owns cash and the forecast; the team models, prices, keeps the books and prepares investor material.

project.name: Finance
project.goal: Know where the money is going, what is coming, and what to do about it.

members.title: Chief Financial Officer
members.name: Jonathan
focus: Keep the thirteen-week cash forecast and the monthly finance review.

members.title: Financial Analyst
members.name: Mina
focus: Build the budget and compare actuals every month.

members.title: Pricing Analyst
members.name: Samuel
focus: Check margins by product and suggest price tests.

members.title: Bookkeeper
members.name: Elif
focus: Keep the books current so the numbers can be trusted.

members.title: Investor Relations
members.name: Ravi
focus: Draft the monthly investor update and keep the fundraising list.
